interpretation: steps are ordered task/branch families; failure_recovery describes alternatives, not mandatory linear execution of every named command

journeys.name: Draft to first published offer
journeys.failure_recovery: Account/provider return preserves draft; version conflict compares; readiness missing stays draft; publication requires exact reviewed revision; no auto-publish.
journeys.notification_rule: Only deliberate verified account/invite/security messages. No marketing from signup.
journeys.terminal_truth: Same Business/Offer IDs across onboarding/Studio/public page, public version distinct from draft.

journeys.name: Service booking with optional deposit
journeys.failure_recovery: No-upfront branches directly to confirmed only under configured instant/request rule; required payment remains pending; late success after hold expiry rechecks capacity then refund/recovery; retries same operation.
journeys.notification_rule: Confirmation once after authoritative state; pending says pending; necessary reminders recheck current date/status/version.
journeys.terminal_truth: Booking, Payment, DepositAllocation and AgreementSnapshot agree; redirect alone never confirmation.

journeys.name: Native product order and fulfilment
journeys.failure_recovery: Last unit transaction; invalid variant/shipping total re-review; partial fulfilment explicit line quantity; unknown capture reconciles; abandoned holds expire once.
journeys.notification_rule: Order/receipt/collection/dispatch separate template triggers; no campaign opt-in assumed.
journeys.terminal_truth: Money captured and line-level stock/fulfilment tracked independently.

journeys.name: Class, participants and waitlist
journeys.failure_recovery: Seats count participants; if full, explicit uncharged waitlist, not simultaneous booking+waitlist; promotion FIFO whole party with timed offer, no auto-charge.
journeys.notification_rule: Attendee reminders use actual occurrence/timezone; waitlist notice is scoped operational contact.
journeys.terminal_truth: Capacity/host/room allocations and participant rights persist; package credit separate record/ledger requirement.

journeys.name: Quote-led mobile/creative work
journeys.failure_recovery: Enquiry/quote acceptance not automatically schedule; material scope/price variation requires fresh acceptance; unsupported address blocks actual booking, not silent higher price.
journeys.notification_rule: Quote/deliberate variation/review notices protect private files/address.
journeys.terminal_truth: Accepted scope/version plus actual separate reserved date and payment authority.

journeys.name: Reschedule, cancellation and refund
journeys.failure_recovery: Reschedule and cancellation are alternatives; stale assessment re-evaluates; statutory/disputed loss review; partial paid goods/services separate; unknown refund retrieves original operation.
journeys.notification_rule: Explain impact before action; cancellation recorded independent refund processing; durable receipt.
journeys.terminal_truth: No blanket keep-deposit; refund total bounded by captured minus prior active refunds.

journeys.name: Completed work to Wallet return and redemption
journeys.failure_recovery: Static QR resolves only; holder challenge protected current relationship; staff current grant; concurrent redeem at most once; source refund appends reversal/recovery.
journeys.notification_rule: Wallet update queued is not immediate display; programme marketing permission separate.
journeys.terminal_truth: Append-only reward ledger authoritative; provider cache/offline screenshot never account authority.

journeys.name: Draft to approved campaign and suppression
journeys.failure_recovery: Unsubscribe is independent anytime, not mandatory step after scheduling; approval invalid after edit; dispatch rechecks consent; definite rejection releases quota once; unknown provider acceptance reconciles.
journeys.notification_rule: No optional promotion in operational templates; no provider failover bypassing suppression.
journeys.terminal_truth: Recipient-send accounting vs actual provider segments, one logical send per purpose/source/recipient.

journeys.name: Staff invite, work and departure
journeys.failure_recovery: Removed membership/session/grants/cache access immediately; future accepted work reviewed/reassigned with customer rights; public link current fallback not unrelated employer.
journeys.notification_rule: Invitation deliberate; departure/assignment notices minimise private data.
journeys.terminal_truth: Historic attributed actions/agreements retained; login/resource/profile/seller remain distinct.

journeys.name: Report, proportionate restriction and appeal
journeys.failure_recovery: Report count alone not guilt; reviewer conflict logged; preserve accepted work/refunds/private receipts; restrict minimum scope and issue appropriate notice.
journeys.notification_rule: Reporter privacy and target reasons/evidence projections separated; no retaliation.
journeys.terminal_truth: Decision versions/case/audit and appeal outcome with actual workforce authority.

journeys.name: Subscription change, domain/record exit
journeys.failure_recovery: Downgrade next renewal; excess offer/location selection deliberate; obligations and required receipts/rewards retained; legal holds restrict deletion; domain ownership/renewal distinct SaaS cancel.
journeys.notification_rule: Notice actual effect/date/export choices; no deletion from marketing unsubscribe.
journeys.terminal_truth: Closure completion requires resolved accepted work/refunds/retention; not one global deleted boolean.

journeys.name: Unknown provider state to Console recovery
journeys.failure_recovery: Current authorised Console reconciles actual provider reference; no guessed payment/refund/manual data edit; restore pauses side-effect replay until provider truth matched.
journeys.notification_rule: Persistent case next owner/action; genuine status update not false success toast.
